en.explanation:
We know,

Young's modulus (Y) =

[Y] = = [ ML-1T-2]

Let [Y] = [V]x [A]y [F]z

[ ML-1T-2] =

[LT-1]x [LT-2]y [MLT-2]z

[ ML-1T-2] =

[ Mz Lx + y + z T-x -2y - 2z

For dimensional balance, the dimension on both sides should be same.

So, z = 1

x + y + z = -1

x + y = -2 ........(1)

and -x -2y - 2z = -2

x + 2y = 0 ...........(2)

By solving those two equations we get,

x = -4 and y = 2

[Y] = V4A2F1
